story_title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 MLPerf v6.1 Debut
caption:
NVIDIA just released preview MLPerf Inference v6.1 results for its new Vera Rubin NVL72 platform.

While throughput jumps up to 3.7x on Qwen3-VL and 2.5x on DeepSeek-R1 compared to GB300 NVL72, the standout metric is in agentic testing: Vera Rubin delivered 30x performance over GB300 NVL72 on the SemiAnalysis AgentX benchmark.

Here is what the latest MLPerf benchmark numbers reveal about the direction of AI infrastructure.

—

pinned_comment: Which benchmark metric matters most to you: raw throughput or agentic multi-step execution?
alt_text_overall: Carousel slide detailing NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 MLPerf v6.1 benchmark results showing up to 30x performance jump on agentic workloads.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: 30× FASTER FOR AI AGENTS.. NVIDIA just dropped MLPerf Inference v6.1 preview results for its next-gen Vera Rubin NVL72 architecture. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: BLACKWELL WASN'T THE CEILING.. While GB300 NVL72 systems are rolling out to data centers, Vera Rubin preview submissions show massive gains across demanding AI inference benchmarks. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 3: 3.7× THROUGHPUT ON VISION-LLMS.. In official MLPerf v6.1 preview tests, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 3.7× higher throughput on Qwen3-VL and up to 2.5× on DeepSeek-R1 compared to GB300 NVL72. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 4: THE 30× AGENTIC LEAP.. Traditional LLM benchmarks measure raw token generation. On SemiAnalysis AgentX—built to test multi-step reasoning agents—Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered 30× better performance than GB300 NVL72. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 5: 288 GPUs. 99% EFFICIENCY.. Scaling four GB300 NVL72 racks together (288 GPUs total) achieved 99% scaling efficiency on DeepSeek-R1, proving throughput grows almost linearly without network bottlenecks. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 6: REASONING IS BECOMING CHEAPER.. For AI builders, higher tokens-per-second per rack directly lowers the operational cost of multi-step agent execution. Complex AI reasoning workflows are becoming economically viable at mass scale. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 7: HARDWARE IS PREPARING FOR AGENTS.. The AI bottleneck is shifting from static text generation to multi-step agent reasoning. Rubin's architecture shows chipmakers are now designing hardware around agentic loops. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
